title: Run Digest Retry Truth: partial enrichment shows repair attempts

claims.summary: The release is grounded in the v0.15.75 Project Management ZIP/log audit that showed two native enrichment recovery calls while the readable digest incorrectly reported zero retry calls.
Run digests now derive retryCallCount from recorded repair-stage retry calls when those are present, while preserving finish-stage retry counts separately.
Partial-enrichment flagged checks now say when the fallback remained after repair/retry calls, so reviewers can distinguish no-retry regressions from retried-but-unsuccessful model output.
The release notes explicitly carry forward the need for a fresh deployed audit and do not claim a clean 100/100 package.

carryForward.next: After deploy, run a fresh EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit and verify quality score, texture, enrichment coverage, source relevance, package card state, and export UI truth.
If the next audit still shows partial enrichment after recorded repair retries, improve the kernel recovery path or block earlier with a clearer repair state.
Verify whether v0.15.76 Project Management source-topic gating removed off-discipline trusted readings.
